about: The VFX reference catalogue (docs/refs/README.md). Links, credits, tags and our own short notes only: media stays in .cache/refs/inbox/<local>, never in this public repo. licence: cc0 (may ship, see docs/cc0-library.md) or reference (study only). target: how close it is to SE370's look (stylized shapes with realistic touches).

refs.title: Simonschreibt News #25 (VFX picks)
refs.creator: Simon Schreibt
refs.notes: Six recommended pieces: a comic/print-style stylized boom, a beam teleport impact worth frame-stepping, fire tentacles, Path of Exile 2 ghost tentacles, a VFX reel, a punchy purple snake summon, a water splash paint study.

refs.title: Game Art Tricks (97 articles)
refs.creator: Simon Schreibt
refs.notes: How shipped games fake their effects. All 97 are noted locally (notes.md); the 15 most useful for stylized Roblox VFX are listed in `most_useful`.

most_useful.title: Battlefront II: Layered Explosion
most_useful.why: matched smoke and fire layers from one flipbook: the base of an explosion kit

most_useful.title: Fallout 4: The Mushroom Case
most_useful.why: one grey looping billow coloured over lifetime; the fire-to-smoke handoff

most_useful.title: GTA V: Underestimated Glow
most_useful.why: glow as a painted texture layer, not a bloom setting; twin counter-rotating glare cards

most_useful.title: Pokemon: Rapidash
most_useful.why: stylized fire needs separate layers for volume and for silhouette (chunky tongues)

most_useful.title: Tomb Raider: Lara's Hot Secrets
most_useful.why: moving fire as a ribbon plus particles spawned by distance; crossfaded loops

most_useful.title: Stylized VFX in RIME
most_useful.why: erosion baked into smoke flipbooks, light painted in; fades that read as smoke

most_useful.title: Diablo 3: Wings of Angels
most_useful.why: the Beam streamer recipe: scrolling strips, wide to narrow, tip fade, offset speeds

most_useful.title: Company of Heroes: Flamethrower
most_useful.why: sprayed effects: beam body, velocity-aligned sparks, a landing layer where it hits

most_useful.title: Zelda: The Bling-Bling Offset
most_useful.why: ZOffset toward the camera to stop clipping, away for auras

most_useful.title: Jedi: Fallen Order: Splishy Splashy
most_useful.why: a water kit of body, droplets and mist, chosen by scale

most_useful.title: The Divine Fire
most_useful.why: lead-in, loop and lead-out phases for state effects (burning, buffs)

most_useful.title: Zelda Wind Waker: Hyrule Travel Guide
most_useful.why: cartoon smoke as a family of swirl puffs, one per occasion

most_useful.title: Binding of Isaac: Composition
most_useful.why: readability tiers: gameplay effects out-contrast ambient ones

most_useful.title: Cel Shading
most_useful.why: outlines for the anime side, painted into textures or as inverted-hull shells

refs.title: #VFXFriday community reel
refs.creator: VFX Apprentice community
refs.notes: A red star burst; a slash into red spikes and cartoon smoke; Spellcasters concepts (purple orb, tsunami, rock wave); a purple magic circle rising into a spiral pillar.

refs.title: Last Flag: Lumberjack Ancestral Spirit Attack, Archer Healing Arrow, Spectral Shot (concepts)
refs.creator: Geoffrey Amesse, Dardo Studios
refs.notes: The style anchor. Flat painted shapes with hard edges; a dome or arc silhouette with a spiky starburst inside; ground rings and splashes; one element colour per variant; black ink strokes as accents; leaves and chunky debris as dust; glowing character rims; vortex portals.

refs.title: Professional VFX Portfolio class reel
refs.creator: VFX Apprentice students (Antonio Manzi, Axel Mortensen, Ian Boyle, Daryna Masiahina, others)
refs.notes: Stylized slashes with black ink accents, a magenta smear and a starburst impact frame, then a red full-screen impact silhouette (Axel Mortensen); a ground crack into a gold rune circle; a charge into a red laser; a white flash with a rainbow-fringed ring.

refs.title: Before and after: comet projectile
refs.creator: VFX Apprentice students
refs.notes: Great over good: one comet silhouette instead of competing lines and a hard core; one warm palette; a soft bright head; faint blue and pink fringes along the trail; residual streaks as it leaves.

refs.title: Before and after: braziers
refs.creator: VFX Apprentice students
refs.notes: Great over good: a neutral stage instead of coloured spill; a white-hot core inside the coloured flame; dark smoke wisps rising above it; cleaner contrast.

refs.title: Before and after: fire pillar
refs.creator: VFX Apprentice students
refs.notes: Great over good: the fire spreads into a wide ground ring and resolves sooner, instead of a tall busy pillar with chaotic spray; it ends calm with a scorch, debris and a few embers.

refs.title: Stylized Fire Pit
refs.creator: Daryll Española
refs.notes: The exact mix to aim for: a hex-cracked glowing ground decal; a burst of chunky stylized flame tongues with soft dark smoke, sparks and a red ground glow; then a small steady fire loops on the cracks.

refs.title: Elemental Projectile Study
refs.creator: Iris Sebirot
refs.notes: Fire and water projectiles: a white-hot core grading through the element's colours to a dark smoky tail; ribbon strands curling off the body; sparks; a coloured light cast on the floor. Hand-painted shapes with soft volumetric shading.
